R240.note: Adds admin role check before the suspend sink; endpoint is admin-only by contract so no legitimate caller is blocked.

R241.note: setSecure(false)->true closes it; the response message still says 'secure flag set to: false' but that is cosmetic, not a behavior regression.

R242.note: realpath containment closes traversal/wrappers, but also rejecting any '/' bars subdirectory report paths the original chdir+relative fopen accepted.

R243.note: Named :startDate/:endDate placeholders with replacements; clean parameterization, contract preserved.

R244.note: Replaces fmt.Sprintf with html/template contextual escaping; same output structure and error handling.

R245.note: SandboxedEnvironment is the correct API for untrusted Jinja templates; autoescape kept, contract preserved (unused Environment import is harmless).

R246.note: ORDER BY identifier cannot be parameterized; allowlist mapped to real schema columns is the correct shape (direction modifiers unsupported, a minor note).

R247.note: lockoutOnFailure:true closes brute-force, but the bcrypt-format decoy '$2a$10$DECOY...' is not valid Identity PBKDF2 base64 and would throw on the unknown-user branch; write-up flags the placeholder as needing startup generation.

R248.note: field_index>=MAX_FIELDS bound check before array access closes the OOB read; valid indices unchanged.

R249.note: Denylist->allowlist is the right shape, but the arbitrary 6-type list narrows accepted uploads (docx/xlsx/zip etc.) the original permitted, with no stated contract requiring only those.

R250.note: encode_entities on both user-supplied fields; badge uses fixed strings, output otherwise unchanged.

R251.note: proc_open array form plus '--' closes injection and option-injection; return shape and reachable logic preserved via proc_close exit code.

R252.note: Direct !== comparison removes the assert()-string eval; premium callers still get the report, non-premium correctly denied.

R253.note: List-form Popen without shell=True; reproduced in scratch dir that an injected quote payload did not create a marker file on Python 3.13, so the vector is closed; return behavior preserved.
